# The third version of frog-daliy-summary

## New Feature: This is a major release — not just a module update or bug fix, but a significant leap forward.
### Integrated cloud infrastructure — including download servers, landing pages, user profile pages, and an admin management system — and built out the entire cloud-to-software ecosystem, from authentication to complex data communication, bringing the system to a production-ready state.


## The next version will include an updated time period heatmap. But maybe fix some small problem first.
